title: Stations
subtitle: Choose a station to open.
embeddedDescription: The station that runs with the desktop client

empty.title: No remote stations yet
empty.description: Add a TX-5DR station on your network or the internet, then open it from here or the tray menu at any time.

editor.label: Name
editor.urlDescription: A host name or IP alone uses http and port 8076.

probe.okDescription: Version {{version}}. Sign in through the station interface the first time you connect.

remove.title: Remove Station
remove.body: Remove “{{label}}”? Its sign-in stored on this computer is removed as well.

connect.title: Connecting
connect.portReassigned: The local port was in use, so a new one was assigned; sign in again.

cert.subject: Subject
cert.untrustedBody: This station uses a certificate the system does not trust (for example a self-signed one). Compare the fingerprint with the one shown on the station before trusting it. Connections are blocked if the certificate changes later.
cert.changedBody: The station presented a different certificate from the one you trusted, so the connection was blocked. If you know the station replaced its certificate, verify the new fingerprint and trust it again; otherwise someone may be intercepting the connection.
cert.changedConfirm: I verified the new fingerprint and the station replaced its certificate

errors.unreachable: Cannot reach this address ({{code}}). Check that the station is running, the address and port are correct, and the network is reachable.
errors.notStation: This address did not return a TX-5DR station identity. It may not be TX-5DR, or the station is too old; update the station first.
errors.bridgeTooOld: This station requires a newer desktop client (bridge version {{required}}). Update the TX-5DR desktop client first.
errors.redirect: The station redirected the request to {{location}}. Use that address directly.
errors.gateway: The local connection failed to start ({{code}}).
errors.load: The station interface failed to load ({{code}}).
errors.invalidUrl: Invalid address. Enter a host name or IP, optionally with a port and http/https.

discovered.title: Stations on your network
discovered.description: These stations are announcing themselves on the local network. Add one to open it.
